paite: Ikoniam ah Judate sinagog ah alutkhawm ua, thu agen zel uhi, huchi in Judate leh Grik mipi tampi in leng agingtata uhi.
heading: Paul Leh Barnabas Ikoniam Ah

paite: Himahleh agingta nuam lou Judate'n Zentelte lungsim atokthou ua, unaute ahosak uhi.
Huaiziak in Toupa ah hangtak a thu gen in huai ah sawt sim a-om uhi. Ama'n chiamtehna leh thillamdangte akhut ua hihsak in, ahehpihna thu atheisak zel hi.
Himahleh khua a mipite akilangta ua, akhen in Judate agum ua, akhen in sawltakte agum uhi.
Zentelte leh Judate aheutute uh toh pangkhawm in sawltakte simmohhuaitak a bawl a suang a den atup lai un,
amau ana thei ua, Likonia gam mah, Listra leh Darbi ah leh akim gam ah ataimang uhi.
Huai ah tanchinhoih agen zom zel uhi.
Listra ah khezaw kuahiam atu a, apian tung a pan khebai him ahi a, khe in apai ngei kei hi.
heading: Listra Ah Paul Leh Barnabas

paite: Huai mi'n Paul thugen angaikhia a; huan Paul in a-en gegu a, damna ding in ginna anei chih athei a, aw ngaihtak in, “Na khe in dingtang in,” achi hi.
Huan amah atawm a, khe in apaita hi.
Mipite'n Paul thilhih amuh un, Likonia pau in aw ngaihtak in, “Mihing melpu in i kiang uah pathiante ahong sukta uh e!" achi uhi.
Amaute'n Barnabas pen, "Jupiter" achi ua, Paul bel thugenpi pen ahih ziak in, "Hermes" achi uhi.
Huan Jupiter siampu, khopi lutna a atempul om in, bawngtalte leh pakkhigui limte kongpi ah ahon tawi a, mipite toh biakna ding in lat atum uhi.
Himahleh sawltak Barnabas leh Paul in huai azak un, apuan uh abotkek ua, mipi lak ah adianglut ua, akikou uhi.

"Pute aw, hiai thilte bangziak a hih na hi ua? Kou leng noumau hindan toh kibang pu, mihing ka hi ve ua le; hiai thil ginaloute na kiheisan ua, van, lei, tuipi leh asung ua om tengteng bawlpa Pathian hing kiang a na hong kiheina ding un tanchinhoih ka hon tun uhi.
Pathian in nidanglai in nam chih amau lampi chiat zuih aphal hi.
Himahleh amah theihsakna om lou in akibawl kei, huchi in thil ahihhoih zel a, van a kipan in vuahtui ahon pia a, na lungtang uh nek ding leh kipahna a hihdim gige akei hiam," achi uhi.
Huchi in huai thu in mipite'n amaute biakna dia gan agoh ding uh akhamzou teitei hi.
Himahleh Antiok leh Ikoniam ah Juda mi kuate hiam ahong ua, mipite akhempukta uhi; huchi in suang in Paul adeng ua, si hi a agintak ziak un khua a kipan akaikhia uhi.
Himahleh nungzuite akim a adin lai un, ahong thou a, khua ah alut nawnta hi. Huan azing in Barnabas toh Darbi ah apaita uhi.
Huan huai khuate kiang ah tanchinhoih ahilh ua, nungzui tampi abawl nung un Listra, Ikoniam leh Antiok khua ah akik nawn uhi.
heading: Siria Antiok A Kik Nawnna

paite: Gim tampi thuak in Pathian lalgam i lut ding ahi him ahi, chi in nungzuite lungsim ahihkip ua, ginna a om gige ding in ahanthawn uhi.
Huan saptuam pawl teng ah upate asehsak ua, an ngawl kawm a athum khit un, agin uh Toupa kiang ah akemsak zelzel uhi.
Pisidia gam atawnsuak ua, Pamphilia gam atung uhi.
Perga a thu agen khit un Attalia ah ahohsuk uhi.
Huai a kipan in long in apawt ua, Antiok khua ahong tung nawnta uhi. Huai mun ahi tua athilhih khitsa uh hih ding a unaute'n Pathian hehpihna a kemsak a asawlkhiakna uh.
Huan a tun nung un asaptuamte asamkhawm ua, Pathian in, amaute zang a athilhihte leh Zentelte a dia ginna kongkhak ahonsakdan ahilh uhi.
Huan nungzuite kiang ah sawt sim a-om uhi.
